profile.headline: Software Engineer @ AWS
profile.summary: Hello I am Jeffrey! As a motivated Computer Science student at the University of Rhode Island, I have cultivated a strong foundation in programming, software development, and collaborative problem-solving. My internships at Amazon Web Services allowed me to apply technical skills like Python, C++, and deployment pipelines to real-world challenges, automating processes that saved engineers significant time and effort. These experiences honed my ability to design scalable solutions and adhere to industry best practices, all while collaborating in agile development environments.
